review_locator: PMCID:PMC4488900, Role of group 3 innate lymphoid cells in antibody production; PMCID:PMC4005806, Innate lymphoid cells integrate stromal and immunological signals to enhance antibody production by splenic marginal zone B cells
primary_title: Innate lymphoid cells integrate stromal and immune signals to enhance antibody production by splenic marginal zone B cells
decision_basis: The review identifies the Magri primary showing that splenic ILCs express GM-CSF and that Csf2 deficiency or transfer of Csf2-deficient ILCs is associated with reduced splenic neutrophils, while GM-CSF-expressing rescue increases them.
limitations_preserved: Cell-to-cell functional bridge with GM-CSF dependence; preserve mouse splenic ILC and neutrophil context, distinguish ILC Csf2 expression from directly measured secreted protein, and do not infer a unique CSF2 receptor subunit, SCI relevance, or terminal-TF effect.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3432803, Activation of B cells by non-canonical helper signals; PMCID:PMC3262910, B-helper neutrophils stimulate immunoglobulin diversification and production in the marginal zone of the spleen
primary_title: B-cell-helper neutrophils stimulate immunoglobulin diversification and production in the marginal zone of the spleen
decision_basis: The review identifies the Puga primary showing that human splenic B-cell-helper neutrophils stimulate IgM production by marginal-zone B cells, with conditioned-medium activity and blockade of BAFF/APRIL/IL-21 reducing the response.
limitations_preserved: Cell-level functional bridge; preserve human splenic B-helper neutrophil and MZ-B-cell context and the combined BAFF/APRIL/IL-21 mechanism, without assigning sole mediator necessity, transcript-to-protein steps, SCI relevance, or terminal-TF effects.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3432803, Activation of B cells by non-canonical helper signals; PMCID:PMC3262910, B-helper neutrophils stimulate immunoglobulin diversification and production in the marginal zone of the spleen
primary_title: B-cell-helper neutrophils stimulate immunoglobulin diversification and production in the marginal zone of the spleen
decision_basis: The review identifies the Puga primary showing that human splenic B-cell-helper neutrophils promote plasmablast differentiation of marginal-zone B cells alongside IgM and class-switched antibody production.
limitations_preserved: Cell-state functional bridge; preserve human splenic neutrophil-to-MZ-B-cell context and distinguish plasmablast frequency from Ig secretion rate and from AICDA transcription, without inferring a single mediator, SCI relevance, or terminal-TF effect.
